entry.title: Virtuální Bastlírna vol. 51: česká open source LoRa meteostanice
entry.summary:
Ač semestr ve škole právě končí, bastlíři ze studentského klubu Silicon Hill neodpočívají a opět se jako každý měsíc hlásí s pravidelným bastlířským setkáním Virtuální Bastlírna, kde si můžete s ostatními techniky popovídat jako u piva o novinkách, o elektronice, softwaru, vědě, technice obecně, ale také o bizarních tématech, která se za poslední měsíc na internetu vyskytla.
Z novinek za zmínku stojí Maker Faire, kde Pájeníčko předvedlo open source meteostanici a kde se objevila náhrada Lego Mindstorm ze spolupráce ČVUT a firmy BTL. Začala se prodávat nová tiskárna od Bambu Labs a už probíhá její testování.
Za hardware stojí za pozornost vnitřek rozebraného Starlinku, drahé USB-C nabíječky nebo Thunderbolt dokovací stanice. Philips začal nabízet modely náhradních dílů k vytištění a Tesla opravuje kovové konstrukce aut pomocí lepidla. Vznikl i šikovný PoE adaptér na GPIB.
Ze softwarového světa se může hodit bezdrátový logický analyzátor, open source toolchain pro Xilinx nebo Pidipad, tedy konzole s VGA běžící na CH32V002 nebo vizuální simulace polovodičů.
A nakonec za bizarní témata můžou strahováci prozradit falešnou AI spoléhající na práci 700 lidí, další exploze Starshipu, 250W "příruční laser" nebo jak tisknout na 3D tiskárně mýdlo.
Příští Virtuální Bastlírna se pod taktovkou projektu MacGyver studentského klubu SiliconHill bude konat ve čtvrtek 12. června od 20:00 minimálně do 22:00 (ale obvykle končí o dost později). Odkaz na konferenci se před samotnou akcí objeví na bastlířské wiki.

entry.title: How to repair your items and vehicles in Dune Awakening
entry.summary:
Dune Awakening, staying true to the MMO genre, offers plenty of items and vehicles to unlock, but it's important to repair all of them throughout your journey.
All items, including your vehicle, will take damage over time. Their durability will go down, and they can stop functioning without repairs. The process of repairs varies slightly depending on whether it's an item or your vehicle. You can also repair building parts, but that's done with the crafting tool. Let's first look at how to repair general items, followed by vehicles.
Table of contents How to repair items in Dune Awakening How to repair your vehicles in Dune Awakening
How to repair items in Dune Awakening
For repairs, you'll need a Repair Station. The blueprint has to be researched first from the Research section. To do so, complete the Maintenance quest in the Vermillius Gap Journey. Once done, you'll get the option to research and craft the Repair Station.
Place the Repair Station in your base and interact with it. Place the item you want to repair and supply the required raw materials. The process will take a little while to complete, and your items will be as good as new. The amount of resources you need will vary based on the item and its condition.
Screenshot via Funcom
How to repair your vehicles in Dune Awakening
Whether you're using an Ornithopter or a bike, vehicles will take damage. You'll have to repair them before major journeys to prevent them from breaking down. For vehicles, you don't need a Repair Station. Instead, your Welding Tool should be more than good enough. For most vehicles, you'll need Welding Wire.
The Fabricator produces both the Welding Tool and Welding Wire. The Fabricator unlocks pretty quickly (again, research it to unlock the blueprint), and you can position it on your base. Always craft plenty of Welding Wires on your travels, as repairing vehicles can quickly empty your stock.

entry.title: How to get the Holtzman Amplifier in Dune Awakening
entry.summary:
The Holtzman Amplifier is an important quest item in Dune Awakening if you want to complete the Scrap Mettle series of quests.
It's easy to miss, as completing this set of missions is not part of the main storyline. Instead, these side contracts will help you earn extra rewards to boost your early game progression. Let's learn how to find and use the Holtzman Amplifier on your journey in Arrakis. We begin by starting the Scrap Mettle: Wrecking Crew quest.
Dune Awakening Scrap Mettle: Wrecking Crew quest guide
Starting the Scrap Mettle: Wrecking Crew quest is pretty simple: travel to Griffin's Reach and complete the first part of the Scrap Mettle: Copper Required (self-explanatory). This will begin the Wrecking Crew quest. Next up, you'll make your way to Wreck of the Alcyon in Dune Awakening.
Screenshot via Funcom
The exact location is shown in the screenshot above. Travel to the east of the Griffin's Reach at Hagga Basin South. It's quite a journey, so carry a lot of water. Going north through the rocky structures is the quickest way, but avoid the Sandworms (constantly moving and keeping track of the radar).
The Wreck of the Alcyon has a few Scavengers; finish them first. Then, loot all the available stuff and look for the Holtzman Amplifier. There's a chance for the enemies to respawn if you take too long, so keep that in mind.
Go to the main entrance of the location, and then go right towards the back of the ship. You'll find a room with the yellow globe hologram in it. Continue to the back wall, and you'll see a small chest. Open the chest, and you'll get the Holtzman Amplifier. Make sure to loot the other chests, as you'll find plenty of valuable items that can be used for crafting blueprints.
Using it isn't rocket science; just return to Griffin's Reach and deliver it, which automatically begins the Scrap Mettle: Fremen Fields quest.

entry.title: What was your biggest Summer Games Fest reveal?
entry.summary:
Summer Games Fest has now concluded, and we have had a bunch of new game reveals across the multiple shows, from the big Summer Games Fest main show, all the way to the PlayStation State of Play, Xbox Showcase, Wholesome Direct, and more.
There have been multiple game reveals at the event, some good, some bad, and many that might become forgettable as time passes. But as the dust begins to settle on the event, I think it's important to discuss what was our most memorable, or biggest, game reveal from every show over the past few days, for good or bad reasons.
For me, there were a few games that stuck out at the time, either because the reveal surprised me, or because it was a game I had genuine interest in. Most of the Xbox Games Showcase was a treat, with trailer after trailer showcasing titles like Persona 4 Revival, Grounded 2, Super Meat Boy 3D, and a host of other games that excited my friends and me as we watched. It was arguably the best presentation of the entire weekend by far.
There were also indie darlings like Big Walk that got a proper gameplayer trailer in some of the smaller shows, and I imagine a lot of people will be talking about the Resident Evil 9 reveal at the end of the Summer Games Fest main showcase, even if most of the show felt lacklustre at times.
Theres also been a slew of controversal reveals for one reason or another, such as Game Freak's Xbox game reveal of Beast of Reincarnation, which as you can imagine has pissed off a lot of Pokémon fans for the graphics comparisons between it and the Pokémon series as a whole.
A lot of fans were also surprised to see a lack of Switch 2 and Switch 2 game reveals as a whole, but... come on. The console has only been out for a matter of days at this point. You expect brand new announcements so soon? Wait till Gamescom.
But enough talking, what was your biggest pick from the various shows? Let us know in the comments below.

This maintenance release mainly focused on fixing bugs that our developers and users have uncovered since our last stable release. As usual, several engines and platforms received their fair share of bug fixes and improvements: AGI, AGS, Asylum, BAGEL, Bladerunner, Hopkins, MADS, NGI, SCI, SCUMM, Sky, Sword1, Tetraedge, Tinsel, Tucker, TwinE, and TWP. The Nintendo 3DS (yes, we do not care about end-of-life dates!) has the GUI appropriately displayed if it is configured to use the top screen only. Android now provides an option to save and restore your configuration file and save games, and the vast majority of older Android devices will see increased performance thanks to the ARM NEON optimizations, which are now enabled by default. And the Beneath a Steel Sky game is not crashing in the intro anymore! The Atari port received some internal backend, GUI, and audio fixes. Speaking of audio: iOS/iPad will now always properly recognize FluidSynth soundfonts, macOS has support for Audio CD playback from original discs on Snow Leopard and earlier, and Windows 9x (yes, EOL…) can use FLAC files again! The detailed list of improvements is available here. Head over to our downloads page and grab it while it’s hot!
